description: This file manages registration, resolution, and clearing of Discord component and modal entries using global maps, with expiration handling.

methods.name: getComponentEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the global map of Discord component entries, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getModalEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the global map of Discord modal entries, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a given entry has expired based on its 'expiresAt' timestamp.

methods.name: normalizeEntryTimestamps
methods.description: Normalizes 'createdAt' and 'expiresAt' timestamps for an entry based on current time and TTL.

methods.name: registerEntries
methods.description: Registers multiple entries into a store with normalized timestamps.

methods.name: resolveEntry
methods.description: Resolves an entry by ID, deleting it if expired or consumed.
